title: Database connection pool exhausted
symptoms: Payment requests return HTTP 500; active connections reach configured maximum.
root_cause: Connection pool size was too small for peak concurrent payment traffic.
resolution: Raised pool capacity after load testing and added connection acquisition timeout monitoring.

title: Database query timeout
symptoms: Order history requests exceed the 5-second database query timeout.
root_cause: A missing index caused a full table scan on the order_created_at filter.
resolution: Added a composite index and verified the query plan.

title: Database authentication failure
error: FATAL: password authentication failed for user inventory_app
symptoms: Inventory service cannot establish database sessions after secret rotation.
root_cause: The application deployment retained an outdated database password.
resolution: Updated the Kubernetes secret reference and restarted the deployment.

title: Too many database connections
symptoms: Scheduled reports fail while interactive traffic continues normally.
root_cause: A reporting worker opened a new database connection per task and did not close it.
resolution: Introduced connection reuse and guaranteed cleanup in worker finalization.

title: Deadlock during checkout
error: Deadlock found when trying to get lock
symptoms: Some checkout transactions are rolled back during concurrent updates.
root_cause: Two transaction paths updated order and inventory rows in inconsistent order.
resolution: Standardized row-lock acquisition order and added bounded retry handling.

title: Database replica lag
symptoms: Recently updated products are missing from read responses.
root_cause: A large batch update saturated the replica apply process.
resolution: Moved bulk updates to a controlled window and monitored replica lag.

title: Connection refused after database restart
symptoms: User profile requests fail immediately after a database maintenance restart.
root_cause: The application did not retry transient connection failures during database recovery.
resolution: Added exponential backoff with a retry limit and readiness checks.

title: Database disk capacity exhausted
error: could not extend file: No space left on device
symptoms: Ingestion jobs stop and database writes fail.
root_cause: Unbounded temporary table growth consumed the database volume.
resolution: Added retention cleanup, disk alerts, and a larger managed volume.

title: Slow transaction commit
symptoms: Billing API latency increases sharply during end-of-day processing.
root_cause: A long-running transaction held locks while a batch job updated shared rows.
resolution: Split the batch into smaller transactions and reduced lock duration.

title: Connection leak in background worker
symptoms: Notification throughput declines over several hours until database access stalls.
root_cause: An exception path skipped closing JDBC connections in a background worker.
resolution: Used try-with-resources and added connection leak detection.

title: Unhandled null response
symptoms: GET /customers/{id} returns HTTP 500 for customers without an optional address.
root_cause: The response mapper dereferenced a nullable address field.
resolution: Added null-safe mapping and a regression test for missing addresses.

title: Upstream gateway timeout
symptoms: Search requests return HTTP 504 during traffic spikes.
root_cause: The search API waited synchronously for a slow recommendation dependency.
resolution: Added strict downstream timeouts, fallback behavior, and concurrency limits.

title: Malformed JSON request handling
symptoms: Certain profile update requests return HTTP 500 instead of HTTP 400.
root_cause: The exception handler did not map JSON parsing errors to client errors.
resolution: Added explicit request validation and a 400 response mapping.

title: Rate limiter configuration error
error: HTTP 429 returned for low request volume
symptoms: Legitimate clients are throttled shortly after each minute boundary.
root_cause: The rate limiter used a shared counter key across all API clients.
resolution: Changed the key to include the authenticated client identifier.

title: CORS preflight rejected
symptoms: Browser clients cannot call the API; direct server requests succeed.
root_cause: The gateway did not allow the OPTIONS method in its CORS configuration.
resolution: Allowed OPTIONS and required headers in the gateway policy.

title: Incorrect pagination offset
symptoms: Requests for the final page of products fail when the page is partially filled.
root_cause: Pagination code assumed every page contained the configured page size.
resolution: Calculated bounds from the actual result count and added boundary tests.

title: Serialization failure for timestamp
error: InvalidDefinitionException: Java time type not supported
symptoms: Event creation returns HTTP 500 when serializing a timestamp field.
root_cause: The JSON mapper lacked the Java time serialization module.
resolution: Registered the Java time module and standardized timestamp format.

title: Dependency service unavailable
symptoms: Shipping quote endpoint returns HTTP 503 when the carrier adapter is down.
root_cause: The adapter failure was propagated without a controlled service-unavailable response.
resolution: Added circuit breaker behavior and a stable 503 error contract.

title: Request body exceeds limit
symptoms: Large document uploads fail at the gateway before reaching the service.
root_cause: The gateway body-size limit was lower than the documented upload limit.
resolution: Aligned gateway and application upload limits and documented the maximum size.

title: Incorrect HTTP method mapping
symptoms: Admin update calls fail after a client release changed PUT to PATCH.
root_cause: The API route did not expose the PATCH method expected by the new client.
resolution: Added PATCH route support and contract tests.

title: Heap memory leak
symptoms: The service restarts after several hours and memory usage rises continuously.
root_cause: A static cache retained user session objects without eviction.
resolution: Added bounded cache eviction and verified heap usage under soak testing.

title: CPU saturation from inefficient loop
symptoms: Price calculation latency increases after a catalogue size increase.
root_cause: A nested scan compared every product with every promotion.
resolution: Replaced repeated scans with indexed lookups and benchmarked the calculation.

title: Thread pool starvation
symptoms: Image processing requests queue indefinitely and then fail under concurrent load.
root_cause: Blocking file operations occupied every worker thread in the shared pool.
resolution: Separated blocking I/O from CPU work and configured bounded queues.

title: Excessive garbage collection
symptoms: Recommendation latency becomes erratic with frequent long garbage-collection pauses.
root_cause: The request path created large short-lived intermediate collections.
resolution: Reduced allocations and streamed intermediate results.

title: Slow startup due to synchronous dependency checks
symptoms: New instances repeatedly restart during deployment because they do not become ready in time.
root_cause: Startup performed sequential checks against several slow external dependencies.
resolution: Moved noncritical checks after startup and adjusted readiness semantics.

title: Large response payload
symptoms: Audit search endpoint is slow for accounts with many events.
root_cause: The endpoint returned full event payloads when clients needed only summary fields.
resolution: Added field selection, pagination, and response compression.

title: Unbounded in-memory queue
error: Memory usage increased with queue depth
symptoms: Worker memory grows during downstream outages and eventually crashes.
root_cause: Tasks accumulated in an unbounded in-memory queue while processing was blocked.
resolution: Added bounded queue capacity and durable broker backpressure.

title: Connection pool wait under load
error: request threads waiting for HTTP connections
symptoms: Metrics export delays increase and request threads accumulate.
root_cause: The HTTP client connection pool was undersized for concurrent exports.
resolution: Sized the pool using load tests and reused a singleton HTTP client.

title: Regex performance degradation
error: request processing time increased to 12 seconds
symptoms: Specific long user inputs cause severe latency.
root_cause: A backtracking regular expression exhibited catastrophic behavior on crafted input.
resolution: Replaced the expression with a linear-time pattern and added input limits.

title: Disk I/O saturation
symptoms: Log ingestion falls behind during rotation and compression.
root_cause: Compression and ingestion competed for the same slow disk volume.
resolution: Moved temporary files to faster storage and staggered compression jobs.

title: Missing environment variable
symptoms: Authentication requests return HTTP 500 immediately after deployment.
root_cause: The deployment manifest omitted AUTH_TOKEN_ISSUER in the production environment.
resolution: Added the variable to the deployment configuration and validated required settings at startup.

title: Wrong container image tag
symptoms: New checkout pods cannot start after release.
root_cause: The deployment referenced an image tag that was never pushed to the registry.
resolution: Corrected the tag and added image-existence validation to the release pipeline.

title: Incompatible database migration
symptoms: New application pods fail queries during a rolling deployment.
root_cause: The application version was deployed before the database migration completed.
resolution: Applied backward-compatible expand-and-contract migrations before application rollout.

title: Incorrect service port
symptoms: The service is healthy inside the container but unreachable through the cluster service.
root_cause: The service targetPort did not match the container listening port.
resolution: Aligned containerPort and targetPort and added deployment smoke tests.

title: Expired TLS certificate
symptoms: Clients receive TLS handshake failures when connecting to the gateway.
root_cause: Certificate renewal automation had failed without alerting.
resolution: Renewed the certificate and added expiry monitoring with escalation.

title: Config map not mounted
symptoms: Search pods crash on startup after a configuration change.
root_cause: The deployment referenced the wrong ConfigMap name.
resolution: Corrected the ConfigMap reference and added startup configuration validation.

title: Insufficient container memory limit
symptoms: Report workers terminate when generating large monthly reports.
root_cause: The container memory limit was below the measured peak working set.
resolution: Adjusted memory limits and optimized report generation in batches.

title: Broken health check path
symptoms: New pods remain unready although the application starts successfully.
root_cause: The readiness probe called /healthz while the application exposed /health.
resolution: Updated the probe path and added a deployment health-check test.

title: Deployment rollout stalled
symptoms: Release remains partially deployed with old and new pods mixed.
root_cause: A readiness check depended on a noncritical external service unavailable during rollout.
resolution: Changed readiness to test essential local capability and monitored dependencies separately.

title: Incorrect feature flag default
symptoms: A release completes but a subset of checkout traffic follows the obsolete payment path.
root_cause: The production feature flag default was not updated in the release configuration.
resolution: Corrected the flag value and added environment-specific flag verification.

title: JWT signing key mismatch
symptoms: Users are logged out across services after key rotation.
root_cause: The issuer and API gateway loaded different signing-key versions.
resolution: Coordinated key rotation and added key-version overlap during rollout.

title: Expired refresh token accepted incorrectly
symptoms: Some expired sessions continue to access protected endpoints.
root_cause: The refresh-token validation path checked token signature but skipped expiry validation.
resolution: Enforced expiry validation and added negative authentication tests.

title: LDAP connection timeout
symptoms: Corporate users cannot sign in while local accounts continue working.
root_cause: The LDAP endpoint changed and the service retained the old address.
resolution: Updated the endpoint configuration and added LDAP connectivity monitoring.

title: Missing authorization check
symptoms: A user can retrieve a document belonging to another tenant.
root_cause: The document lookup verified authentication but did not enforce tenant ownership.
resolution: Added tenant-scoped authorization checks and security regression tests.

title: CSRF token validation failure
symptoms: Admin form submissions fail after the portal is scaled to multiple replicas.
root_cause: CSRF tokens were stored in process-local memory and requests reached different replicas.
resolution: Moved session state to shared storage and verified cross-replica behavior.

title: OAuth redirect URI mismatch
symptoms: Sign-in through the external identity provider fails after a domain change.
root_cause: The registered callback URL did not match the deployed callback URL.
resolution: Updated the provider registration and added environment-specific callback validation.

title: Secrets exposed in application logs
error: sensitive token detected in log event
symptoms: Security monitoring flags access tokens in request logs.
root_cause: Debug logging recorded the full Authorization header.
resolution: Redacted sensitive headers and added automated log-scrubbing tests.

title: Incorrect session cookie settings
symptoms: Browsers reject or mishandle session cookies on HTTPS pages.
root_cause: Cookie security attributes were not enabled in the production configuration.
resolution: Enabled Secure, HttpOnly, and appropriate SameSite settings.

title: Brute-force protection not applied
error: repeated failed login attempts without throttling
symptoms: A single account receives hundreds of password attempts in a short period.
root_cause: The login endpoint bypassed the shared rate-limiting middleware.
resolution: Applied account-aware throttling and alerting to the login route.

title: Clock skew breaks token validation
symptoms: Inter-service calls intermittently fail token validation across nodes.
root_cause: System clocks drifted beyond the allowed token validation tolerance.
resolution: Enabled time synchronization and added clock-drift monitoring.
